result.instructions: Tools for WeFact, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still unpaid, and how much is outstanding in total?"; "Show me the customer with the email address info@example.com and their open invoices."; "List our active subscriptions and their next invoice dates.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WeFact data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wefact_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wefact_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wefact_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wefact_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wefact_list_debtors
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (debtors) with name, customer code, email and last change. Search with searchfor, pick fields with searchat, filter by customer group. WeFact action: debtor/list.

searchat.description: Fields to search, separated by |. Example: CompanyName|SurName|EmailAddress. Default: DebtorCode|CompanyName|SurName.

group.description: Only customers in this customer group id.

modified_from.description: Only records changed at or after this time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

modified_to.description: Only records changed at or before this time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

limit.description: Results per call (1 to 1000; WeFact default 1000).

tools.name: wefact_get_debtor
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer with address, VAT and tax number, invoice settings, payment mandate and contacts. Give identifier or debtor_code. WeFact action: debtor/show.

debtor_code.description: The customer number, for example DB10000.

tools.name: wefact_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with customer, amounts, paid and outstanding amounts, status and dates. Filter by status, search text, or invoice date and change date ranges. WeFact action: invoice/list.

status.description: Invoice status code (see WeFact variable list, for example 4 = paid).

searchat.description: Fields to search, separated by |. Default: InvoiceCode|CompanyName|SurName.

modified_from.description: Only records changed at or after this time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

modified_to.description: Only records changed at or before this time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

limit.description: Results per call (1 to 1000; WeFact default 1000).

tools.name: wefact_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its lines, totals, paid and outstanding amounts, payment method, reminders and sent dates. Give identifier or invoice_code. WeFact action: invoice/show.

invoice_code.description: The invoice number, for example F2024-0001.

tools.name: wefact_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products and services with code, name, price excluding VAT and VAT rate. Search or filter by product group. WeFact action: product/list.

searchat.description: Fields to search, separated by |. Default: ProductCode|ProductName|ProductKeyPhrase.

group.description: Only products in this product group id.

modified_from.description: Only records changed at or after this time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

modified_to.description: Only records changed at or before this time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

limit.description: Results per call (1 to 1000; WeFact default 1000).

tools.name: wefact_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product with its description, price, VAT rate, price period and groups. Give identifier or product_code. WeFact action: product/show.

product_code.description: The product number, for example P0001.

tools.name: wefact_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring subscriptions (abonnementen) with customer, product, price and next invoice date. Default status: active. WeFact action: subscription/list.

status.description: Subscription status code (see WeFact variable list). Default: active.

searchat.description: Fields to search, separated by |. Default: DebtorCode|ProductCode|Description.

modified_from.description: Only records changed at or after this time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

modified_to.description: Only records changed at or before this time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

limit.description: Results per call (1 to 1000; WeFact default 1000).
